day_local: NgoMgqibelo weVeki yeShamshumi ezimbini neshumi elinesithandathu ngexesha eliqhelekileyo
greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lwenkosi yethu uYesu Kristu kuni nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, sicele uxolo ngenxa yezono zethu. Kristu, sicele uxolo ngenxa yokungathembeki kwethu. Nkosi, sicele uxolo ngenxa yokungabikho kothando lwethu.
psalm_response: Nkosi, vumela ubuso bakho bukhanye phezu kwam.
homily:
Kukho amaxesha empilweni apho sijonga emhlabeni, sibukele iindiza ezinkulu zinyuka zisiya esibhakabhakeni, kwaye sizibuze ukuba ziya phi na. UBenjamin Vo wayengumfana owayethanda ukubukela ezo ndiza. Wayengumfana owayenengqondo eqaqambileyo, owayefuna ukwazi ukuba izinto zisebenza njani—ukusuka kwikhowudi zekhompyutha ukuya kwindlela ezindiza ngayo i-Boeing 737. Kodwa ngaphezu kwayo yonke loo nto, wayengumfana owayenentliziyo enobubele, intliziyo eyayikwazi ukubona ubuhle obuncinci obufihlakeleyo kule ntlupheko yethu yasekhaya. Namhlanje, kwiNcwadi kaYobhi, uYobhi uthi: 'Ndiye ndeva ngawe ngendlebe, kodwa ngoku iliso lam likubonile.'

Cinga ngelo lizwi: 'iliso lam likubonile.' UYobhi wayedlule kwintlungu engathethekiyo. Wayelahlekelwe zizinto ezininzi, waze wazibuza ukuba kutheni na. Kodwa ekugqibeleni, uYobhi akazange afumane impendulo yenzululwazi; wafumana uThixo. Ufumanise ukuba ubomi abuyiyo nje inxalenye yezibalo okanye imithetho yendalo, kodwa bubudlelwane obunzulu noMdali. UBen, ngobomi bakhe obufutshane kodwa obunentsingiselo, wayephila ngaloo nyaniso. Wayengumfana owayejonga kude, owayejonga phezulu, owayefuna ukubona ubukhulu bukaThixo kwiinkcukacha ezincinci zobomi. Ngaba nawe uyakwazi ukubona uThixo kwiinkumbulo zakho zikaBen?

Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba iinyanga ezintathu ezi zidlulileyo bezinzima kakhulu. Ndiyazi ukuba kukho amaxesha apho intliziyo iziva ngathi iyaphuka, xa ucinga ngaloo mntwana owayeza kuwe, owayekuthanda, owayekujonga ngamehlo anothando. Usizi alulandeli ikhalenda. Luza ngexesha lalo, lunzima, lufuna indawo. Ndaye ndifuna ukuba uthethe inyaniso yale ntliziyo yakho namhlanje. Akukho nqaku lokuthi uphosile okanye wenze kakubi. Ukugula akwanga kwenzeka ngenxa yezinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye noBen akakubeki icala. Masikhuphe lo mthwalo wokuzisola emajukujukwini eentliziyo zenu namhlanje. Awuphosanga nto. Ubenze konke okusemandleni enu ngothando olungapheliyo. Ezinye izinto zenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lwethu, ngaphandle kokuba nabani na enze impazamo. Niyinyaniso, nithandwa nguThixo.

KwiVangeli, uYesu uthi kubafundi bakhe: 'Beholani, ndininike amandla okunyathela iinyoka neengwenya.' UYesu akathethi ngokoyisa izilwanyana, uthetha ngokoyisa ubumnyama, ukoyisa usizi, ukoyisa ukufa. Uthi kubo: 'Ngaloo nto, musani ukujabula ngokuba imimoya ithobela nina, kodwa jabulani ngokuba amagama enu ebhaliwe ezulwini.' UBen ngoku unegama lakhe ebhaliwe ezulwini. UBen ukhanya phambi koThixo, ukhanya ngothando lwakhe olungasoze lwavaleleka. UBen wayengumfana owayezimisele ukunikela ngayo yonke into. Khumbula loo mzuzu apho uBen, eneminyaka nje eli-15 ubudala, wayefuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange encinci ukunceda umalume wakhe uWilliam owayehlaselwe zizifo. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, akazange ayikhuphule ngokoqobo, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Wayengumfana owayenokunikela ngayo yonke into yakhe ngaphandle kokubala.

... Yima kancinci apha. Cinga ngaloo mphuphu yothando eyayisentliziyweni kaBenjamin Vo. Wayengumfana owayezisa uvuyo olukhulu kubazali bakhe, umfana owayenentliziyo evulekileyo. U-Alan, utata wakhe, wake waphupha ngoBen ngexesha lonyaka: uBen wayemile ngaphandle komnyango weroom 419, ebila, esithi: 'Ba ơi, test nào con cũng qua hết. Con tự thở được bình thường mà... sao con lại bị như vầy?' Kwaye utata wakhe wamwola waza wathi: 'Từ nay trở đi, con sẽ ở trên Thiên Đàng mãi mãi.' Kwaye uBen wamamatheka wathi: 'Không sao đâu, con sẽ dõi theo ba mẹ.' 

Loo mzuzu usemhlabeni namhlanje. UBen akalahlekanga; ukunye noThixo, ubonisela abazali bakhe nomfowethu uRyan. Ryan, mfowethu omncane, uBen uyamthanda. Ungalokothi uzive ungedwa. Qhubeka uphila ngesibindi, ube ngumfana onobubele, onethemba, oqhubeka nohambo lwenu oludibeneyo. UBen uqhubeka ekhanya, njengaloo mthombo wamanzi owakhiwe eCà Mau ngeligama lakhe—umthombo owenza ukuba abantu abaselubundini bafumane ubomi. Uthando lukaBen aluzange lufe; luyaphila, luqukuqela, kwaye luhamba nani ngalo lonke ixesha.

UYesu uthi: 'Ndiya kunidumisa, Tata, Nkosi yezulu nomhlaba, ngokuba uzifihle ezi zinto kwizilumko nakwabanolwazi, wazityhilela abantwana.' UBen wayengumntwana owayenentliziyo yomntwana, intliziyo eyayikwazi ukuthanda ngaphandle kokubala. Ngaba uyamthanda uThixo njengokuba uBen wayemthanda? Ngaba uyakwazi ukubona ubukhulu bukaThixo ebomini bakho, nokuba buzele yintlungu? UYesu uthi: 'Busisiwe amehlo abona okubonayo nina.' UBen wayebona. Wayebona uthando lukaThixo kuyo yonke into, kwaye ngoku, ubona ubuso bukaThixo ubuso ngobuso.

Alan noThao, ningayeki ukuthanda. Nithandeke kakhulu nguThixo. Xa usizi luhlasela, thabatha elo lizwi likaYesu, uthi: 'Nkosi, ndiyakuthanda, kwaye ndiyakuthemba.' Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Uthando lwakho lulukhanya olungasoze lwavaleleka. Siya kukukhumbula njalo, side sidibane kwakhona apho kungekho nyembezi, apho kukho uvuyo olungunaphakade. UBen uqhubeka esidumisela kuThixo. Uthando lwenu luyaqhubeka luhleli, lusaqhubeka lukhula, kwaye uBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya. Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen nabo bonke abashiyileyo, ukuze baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKristu.
Sithandazela bonke abasemlilweni wosizi, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele abanike ithemba.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: UYobhi waphendula iNkosi wathi: Ndiyazi ukuba unako ukwenza izinto zonke, kwaye akukho njongo yakho enokuthintelwa. Ndithethe ngezinto ezinkulu endingaziqondiyo; izinto ezimangalisayo kum, endingazaziyo. Ndandiva ngawe ngendlebe, kodwa ngoku iliso lam likubonile. Ngoko ke ndiyazilahla izinto endizithethileyo, ndiguquke eluthulini nasemlotheni. Ngoko ke iNkosi yabusisa iintsuku zikaYobhi ezilandelayo ngaphezu kwezokuqala. Wayenempahla ezinkulu, iinkamela, iinkomo, neembila. Wayenabantwana abasixhenxe kunye neentombi ezintathu, abazibiza ngokuthi nguJemimah, Keziah, kunye noKerenhappuch. Akukho bafazi babebahle njengeentombi zikaYobhi kulo lonke ilizwe; kwaye uyise wabanika ilifa kunye nabazalwana babo. Emva koko, uYobhi waphila iminyaka elikhulu namashumi amane; wabona abantwana bakhe, abazukulwana bakhe, kwaye naba-zukulwana babazukulwana bakhe. Waza uYobhi wafa, ekhulile kwaye ezele yiminyaka.

readings.label: Indumiso
readings.text: R. Nkosi, vumela ubuso bakho bukhanye phezu kwam. Fundisa ubulumko nolwazi, kuba ndithembele kwimiyalelo yakho. R. Nkosi, vumela ubuso bakho bukhanye phezu kwam. Kulungile kum ukuba ndibandezelekile, ukuze ndifunde imithetho yakho. R. Nkosi, vumela ubuso bakho bukhanye phezu kwam. Ndiyazi, Nkosi, ukuba izigwebo zakho zilungile, kwaye ngokuthembeka kwakho undibandezelekile. R. Nkosi, vumela ubuso bakho bukhanye phezu kwam. Ngokwezigwebo zakho zisema ngokuqinileyo: zonke izinto zikukhonza wena. R. Nkosi, vumela ubuso bakho bukhanye phezu kwam. Ndingumkhonzi wakho; ndinike ukuqonda ukuze ndazi imithetho yakho. R. Nkosi, vumela ubuso bakho bukhanye phezu kwam. Isityhilelo samazwi akho sikhanyisa, sinika ukuqonda kwabangaziwayo. R. Nkosi, vumela ubuso bakho bukhanye phezu kwam.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: Abafundi abashumi elinesibini babuya bevuyile besithi kuYesu, 'Nkosi, needemon zithobela thina egameni lakho.' UYesu wathi, 'Ndibonile uSathana ewa njengombane esibhakabhakeni. Bheka, ndininikile amandla okunyathela iinyoka neengwenya nakuyo yonke imikhosi yotshaba, kwaye akukho nto iyakunenzakalisa. Noko ke, musani ukujabula ngokuba imimoya ithobela nina, kodwa jabulani ngokuba amagama enu ebhaliwe ezulwini.' Ngaloo mzuzu wajabula kuMoya oyiNgcwele wathi, 'Ndiyakudumisa, Tata, Nkosi yezulu nomhlaba, ngokuba uzifihle ezi zinto kwizilumko nakwabanolwazi, wazityhilela abantwana. Ewe, Tata, oko bekuyintando yakho enobubele. Zonke izinto zinikezelwe kum nguTata. Akukho mntu waziyo ukuba unguNyana ngaphandle kukaTata, nokuba unguTata ngaphandle koNyana, naye nabani na uNyana athanda ukumtyhilela yena.' Eguqukele kubafundi ngasese wathi, 'Busisiwe amehlo abona okubonayo nina. Kuba ndithi kuni, abaprofeti nookumkani abaninzi babenqwenela ukubona okubonayo nina, kodwa abazange babona, nokuva okuvayo nina, kodwa abazange bava.'

spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu Kristu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona ngokwenene kwiSakramente eliNgcwele le-Altar. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwako konke, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenakukwamkela ngoku kwiSakramente, nceda uze kum ngomoya entliziyweni yam. Ndiyakwamkela njengokungathi sele ulapha, kwaye ndizibophelela ngokupheleleyo kuwe. Ungaze uvumele ukuba ndahlukane nawe. Amen.
closing: Makube nalo uxolo lukaThixo olugqithise konke ukuqonda ezintliziyweni zenu. Hamba ngoxolo lweNkosi.
day: Saturday of the Twenty-sixth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.
